note: The authoritative universe: what the retrieved sources establish, and nothing else. An estate is here because a classification body lists it; a wine is here because a classification classifies it or the estate itself publishes it. Fields a source does not give are null, not guessed.

sources.name: Grands Crus Classés en 1855 — listing (Médoc; Sauternes & Barsac)
sources.publisher: Conseil des Grands Crus Classés en 1855
sources.authority: membership and rank of the 1855 classification, both lists
sources.geographic_scope: Médoc and Graves (red list); Sauternes and Barsac
sources.temporal_scope: the classification as it stands today (includes the 1973 promotion)
sources.limitations: The Council is the growers' body, not the legal text; the 1855 list has no statute. Gives a place name per cru that mixes communes (Pauillac, Pessac) and appellations (Haut-Médoc). Does not state colour.

sources.name: Histoire du classement
sources.publisher: Conseil des Grands Crus Classés en 1855
sources.limitations: Narrative page; dates only the two amendments it names.

sources.name: Saint-Emilion grand cru : le classement pour la prochaine décennie
sources.authority: membership and rank of the 2022 Saint-Émilion Grand Cru classification
sources.temporal_scope: approved 8 September 2022 for the coming decade; the 2012 list it replaces is described only in counts
sources.limitations: The communiqué of the approval by the INAO national committee; the homologation order itself (Légifrance) was not retrievable. Names in capitals, no communes.

sources.name: Les Crus Bourgeois du Médoc — #CLASSEMENT 2025
sources.publisher: Alliance des Crus Bourgeois du Médoc
sources.authority: membership, tier and appellation of the 2025 Crus Bourgeois
sources.limitations: A designed two-page leaflet: tiers are read from the page bands they are printed in. Cites the homologation of the rules (arrêté of 29 December 2017), not of the list. No vintage range is stated.

sources.name: Les Crus Classés de Graves
sources.authority: current membership of the Crus Classés de Graves, with commune
sources.limitations: Does not say for which colour each cru is classified. The 1959 order and the Union des Crus Classés de Graves site were not retrievable (Légifrance bot challenge; the Union's robots.txt disallows all agents).

sources.name: Classement des vins de Graves (revision 240039963)
sources.authority: the colour(s) for which each Graves cru is classified; the 2006 and 2009 mergers
sources.limitations: Secondary. Used only for colour and the two mergers, which no retrieved primary source states; every value taken from it is marked secondary.
